description: Takes a site down permanently — its files, its history and its subdomain. Nothing here undoes it, and the subdomain becomes available for anybody to claim. Requires `confirm` to repeat the site's own subdomain exactly; ask the person for it rather than filling it in from what you already know, because that is the step this asks for.

confirm.description: The subdomain of the site being deleted, repeated exactly. A mismatch refuses the call rather than guessing which site was meant.

site.description: Subdomain or site id to delete.

name: delete_site

siteId.description: Identifier of the site that was deleted.

title: Delete a site
